notes.session_06_w5: 2026-09-26: Session 06 Wave 5. CombinedNotionAdapter delegates each operation to the API or browser adapter per PLATFORM_COMPATIBILITY.md. reports_unsupported is checked before the call and may route to the other adapter, including for a non-idempotent write, because nothing has been invoked yet. OperationUnsupportedError is raised before any side effect and selects the other adapter only for a read or other idempotent operation. After a non-idempotent write has been invoked, no exception selects the other adapter, including NotImplementedError, its subclasses, and OperationUnsupportedError. A TypeError and an auth-style error propagate and the other adapter is not called. A read or other idempotent operation that raises RuntimeError, ConnectionError, ValueError, KeyError, AttributeError, LookupError, or NotImplementedError propagates that same error, and the other adapter is not called. TypeError and PermissionError on a non-idempotent write, including a browser-preferred write, propagate the same way. When the fallback also fails, the second error is chained from the first. get_public_url is COMBINED: the API delegate returns the public URL and the browser delegate verifies stranger access; None from the API skips the browser, and a failed stranger check returns None. set_view_title_visibility passes database_id, view_id, and visible through unchanged and returns the delegate NotionView. NotionOperationReceipt and NotionOperationReceiptLog are the typed stub from prompt section 4 (job id, operation, workspace, page/database target, pre-state, post-state, provider response, evidence, timestamp, idempotency key, status). Timestamps must be timezone-aware. Status is Success, Unknown, or Failure. A torn trailing line that is not newline-terminated and is not JSON is skipped on load and truncated before the next append, including when several valid lines precede it. An incomplete UTF-8 tail is skipped the same way. A torn tail of deeply nested brackets is skipped rather than raising RecursionError. A complete JSON line with no trailing newline is kept, and a newline is added before the next append. Writers of one resolved path in this process share one lock object and re-read before append. A different path gets a different lock. The lock registry is weak, and each log keeps its lock alive. A str path and a missing parent directory are rejected. Caller mappings are copied before store. Nested mappings, lists, and tuples are frozen at every depth into new containers, so a frozen mapping can be snapshotted again without deepcopy. dataclasses.replace keeps nested pre_state, post_state, and provider_response frozen and equal. 2026-09-26: Session 06 Wave 7. Relation and linked-view helpers from prompt heading ### 6. Implement relation and linked-view helpers. One canonical database per catalogue data type. CanonicalDatabase and CanonicalDatabases reject an unknown data type in __post_init__. Each key must equal its entry data type, data types must not repeat, and the key set must equal data_types. by_type is stored as a copy. Hub views link to that database. Filters are date, category, or status, condition equals, at most 3, and each filter property must exist with a type that fits the dimension. A date filter value must be today, matched exactly, or an ASCII YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. Status values and category values must be options of that property. A date filter on the current_date formula is rejected. Dashboard today view, monthly calendar, and quick notes. The notification dashboard is one row of relations and rollups for Tasks, Events, Finance, and Habits, skipped when that database is absent. The relation must include today's row, and the formula contributes only today's row, so the rollup sum is today's value. water_glasses_remaining subtracts Glasses from Goal only when the Habits Date calendar day is today and is otherwise 0. A hand-built notification dashboard rejects relations that are not a tuple, rollups that are not a tuple, and a rollup that is not a DashboardRollup. Rollup sources must exist on schema_definitions() or as a dashboard formula, and the rollup function must be a known function and must fit the property type. client_name, the configured buyer name, and current_date are not emitted. A repeated screenshot interrupt still leaves that one receipt, with evidence screenshot-failed, and a same-key replay does not click again. A captcha, verification, or unknown page fails closed, with a screenshot and a tainted session. A page-kind timeout, connection error, or other error records one failure and does not click.
